scope: Internal research index; not a licensed photo or shipping species-data bundle

references.evidence_en: Peaceful, gregarious; gentle flow; 8–10 conspecifics suggested. Names and behavior research, not a complete shipping ecology profile.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 温和群居、柔和水流；来源建议8–10条同种。已核验名称与行为研究，未完成发布生态参数。

references.evidence_en: Dimly lit planted habitat, schooling, similar-sized peaceful companions; adult tank dimensions still apply.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 偏昏暗有遮蔽环境、群居，搭配体型相近温和物种；仍需独立评估成体空间。

references.evidence_en: Cooler conditions; permanent warmer exposure cautioned against. Kept out of the default tropical route.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 偏凉水，页面提醒长期偏暖会缩短寿命；不作为默认热带教学缸的通用入门鱼。

references.evidence_en: Formerly Corydoras panda; sandy substrate, conspecific group, sinking food; not a feces-cleaning tool.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 旧名Corydoras panda，砂底、同种群体、沉底食物；不会吃粪并消除氮负荷。

references.evidence_en: Formerly Corydoras pygmaeus; notable midwater swimming, illustrating why not all cory profiles are bottom-locked.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 旧名Corydoras pygmaeus；会在中层游动，不能给所有鼠鱼套锁底模型。

references.evidence_en: Fin-nipping risk, especially with limited space or insufficient numbers; long-finned/slow fish poor companions. Reference-only for the 60cm slice.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 啄鳍风险受空间和群体数量影响；不宜长鳍慢游搭配，不进入60cm默认切片。

references.evidence_en: Gentle water flow, tall adult tank; can eat small fish. Future larger-tank content.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 喜柔和水流，成体需高且更大的缸；可能吃小鱼，作为后续内容。

references.evidence_en: Not a standard community recommendation; adult males and most ornamental conspecific combinations require separation and careful review.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 不作标准社区推荐；成年雄性同种隔离，其他组合也需条件审核。

references.evidence_en: Territoriality increases with age; counters the blanket 'timid peaceful shark' characterization. Not default content.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 随年龄增强领地性，纠正泛称其胆小温和；不进入默认内容。

references.evidence_en: Moss/biofilm grazing, shelter and molting behavior references. Secondary hobby source; numerical ranges require further review.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 莫丝和生物膜摄食、躲避与蜕壳参考；爱好者次级资料，数值范围另核验。

references.evidence_en: Multi-species guide only; cannot resolve a model's exact taxon or all breeding requirements. Surface crawling reference.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 多物种指南，不能确认某个模型的具体种，也不能泛化繁殖条件；用于爬附形态参考。

references.evidence_en: Slow growth, shade tolerant, attach to stone/wood; keep rhizome uncovered.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 生长慢、耐阴，可附石木；根茎不可埋没。

references.evidence_en: Low light/CO2 demand, rhizome attachment; dark sporangia under leaves are not automatically disease.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 低光低碳需求，根茎附着；叶背孢子囊黑点不能自动判病。

references.evidence_en: Hardy moss that attaches to hardscape; prune luxuriant growth; fine shelter texture.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 耐养苔藓、可绑附硬景，过密后修剪，细密结构提供躲避。

references.evidence_en: Rosulate, low light/CO2 demand in the profile; placement depends on grown size and tank scale.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 莲座生长，页面标低光低碳；造景位置随成熟尺寸和缸尺度变化。

references.evidence_en: Rhizomatous attachment; reference leaves show wavy edges. Profile title and older Wavy Green prose differ; retain title for name and mark synonym review.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 根茎附着、波浪叶缘；标题与正文旧Wavy Green名称有差异，以标题作英文名并保留别名核验。

references.evidence_en: Policy page states commercial species-data reuse requires written permission; photographs require their own licenses/photographer permission. No permission has been obtained here.
references.evidence_zh_cn: 页面说明商业物种数据再利用需书面许可，照片按各自许可或摄影师授权；本轮未取得再利用许可。
